en.title: A Special Portrait for Dad
en.content: With careful strokes of his pencil, Neale captured something precious - his dad's gentle smile and kind eyes. The black and white portrait shows every detail that matters: the way Dad's eyes crinkle when he's happy, the familiar shape of his face, and that warm expression that makes Neale feel safe. Even without colors, the drawing holds all of Neale's love. He spent extra time getting Dad's smile just right, erasing and redrawing until it looked perfect. When Father's Day arrived, Neale proudly presented his artwork. Dad held the portrait carefully, studying every pencil line, and his eyes grew misty. 'This is the most beautiful gift I've ever received,' Dad whispered, pulling Neale into the biggest hug. Sometimes the most meaningful art comes from the heart, not from a box of crayons.

zh.title: 给爸爸的特别肖像
zh.content: 恩恩用铅笔仔细地勾勒，捕捉到了珍贵的东西——爸爸温和的笑容和善良的眼睛。这幅黑白肖像展现了所有重要的细节：爸爸开心时眼角的皱纹，熟悉的脸型，以及那种让恩恩感到安全的温暖表情。即使没有颜色，这幅画也承载着恩恩所有的爱。他花了额外的时间来画好爸爸的笑容，擦了又画，直到看起来完美为止。父亲节到来时，恩恩自豪地展示了他的艺术作品。爸爸小心地拿着肖像，仔细端详着每一条铅笔线，眼睛湿润了。'这是我收到过的最美丽的礼物，'爸爸轻声说道，给了恩恩一个大大的拥抱。有时候，最有意义的艺术来自内心，而不是来自一盒蜡笔。
